title: Tytuvėnai Bernardine Monastery House

terrainReference.basis: Original Mapzen elevation tile data sampled at the independent building anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap footprint with Lithuanian Cultural Heritage Register identity
mapIdentity.scope: The mapped feature is localized in the geographic reference frame. The shared relation is split at the courtyard and church junctions using the heritage inventory.

note: The monastery house consists of three two-storey brick wings of unequal mass, a rectangular cloister court and a low glazed link along the church. The brick wings have pitched clay-tile roofs.
